data.name: Swaminathan
data.gender_notes: Swaminathan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who leads or governs the gods, or a great master or teacher. The name Swaminathan carries the meaning “Lord of the Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Swaminathan usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a spiritual or enlightened leader or teacher.
data.etymology: Swaminathan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Swaminathan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
